title: gas_stats
tagline: A dapp that helps to generate gas statistics from wallets using moralis
description: This project helps in generating gas statistics from wallets. This project uses Moralis to spin up the server / backend. This helps to query on the EthTransactions table, get notifications when transactions happen, and a cloud Function to Calculate Average Gas Prices. This project helps with gas estimates from wallets transactions.
